data.original: Qual è il voto medio dei film horror?
data.used: Qual è il voto medio dei film horror?

arguments.query: Calcola il voto medio dei film del genere horror.

queries.sql: SELECT g.genre, count(*) AS n_movies, round(avg(s.avg_rating), 3) AS avg_rating, sum(s.n_ratings) AS n_ratings FROM movie_genres g JOIN movie_stats s ON s.movie_id = g.movie_id JOIN movies m ON m.movie_id = g.movie_id WHERE s.n_ratings >= ? AND g.genre = ? GROUP BY g.genre ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, g.genre LIMIT ?
